title: Qualify immutable published Statistics and Quantities binaries under Ubuntu WSL Linux net11
commitMessage: test: qualify published Math Statistics binaries on Linux net11

contribution.summary: Qualify the original published Statistics-Quantities two-package binary consumer under Ubuntu WSL Linux x64 net11.
contribution.value: Verify RS160 and RS137 immutable archive and packaged DLL hashes, copy the original published archives to an isolated WSL feed, restore source-free Statistics PackageReference under Linux SDK11, execute the original eighteen statistical checks and rehash source and snapshot archives. No publishing or production SDK changes.
debtChanges: RS262 succeeded first-pass attempt 001 with the published Statistics-Quantities binary closure on Windows net11.
RS263 extends bounded immutable Statistics binary qualification to Linux x64 net11; wider numerical compatibility, rollback and M8 readiness remain open.
contribution.nextAction: Inspect remaining published Math libraries and relevant numerical changes before proposing any production migration.
